{{CHANGES}}

## Download

- Windows 10/11 64-bit: `tlg-windows-x86_64.zip`
- Linux x86-64 (glibc 2.39+): `tlg-linux-x86_64.tar.gz`. **Untested so far**: reports are welcome
  in [#1](https://github.com/{{REPO}}/issues/1).

Extract it, put `libSceNgs2.sprx` in `system_lib/`, start the launcher, pick your game folder and
press **Play**.

## What you need

- Your own dump of The Last Guardian, CUSA03627 (US) or CUSA03745 (EU), with update 01.03, plus
  `libSceNgs2.sprx` from your PS4 for audio. The full list:
  [game files](https://github.com/{{REPO}}/blob/{{TAG}}/docs/game-files.md).
- A Vulkan 1.3 graphics card with 6 GB of video memory or more. DLAA needs an NVIDIA RTX card.

No game files are included.

Built from commit {{COMMIT}}.
